🎬 Catch Me If You Can (2002)

Catch Me If You Can follows Frank Abagnale Jr., a brilliant and charismatic teenager who becomes one of the most notorious con artists in America before reaching adulthood. After his parents’ marriage falls apart, Frank runs away from home and discovers an extraordinary talent for deception, forgery, and convincing people that he is someone he is not. Using his charm, intelligence, and confidence, he successfully impersonates an airline pilot, a doctor, and a lawyer while traveling across the country and cashing millions of dollars in fraudulent checks. His increasingly elaborate schemes attract the attention of FBI agent Carl Hanratty, a determined investigator who makes it his mission to track Frank down and bring him to justice. As Frank constantly changes identities and stays one step ahead of the authorities, an unusual relationship develops between the clever young fugitive and the persistent agent pursuing him. Beneath his glamorous lifestyle and daring escapes, Frank struggles with loneliness, family problems, and the emotional consequences of his choices. From thrilling airport escapes and clever disguises to unexpected confrontations and dramatic revelations, his journey becomes an extraordinary game of cat and mouse. Inspired by the story of Frank Abagnale Jr., whose accounts have been disputed, the film combines crime, humor, suspense, and heartfelt drama while exploring identity, ambition, deception, family, and the desire to belong.

🎭 Genre: Crime • Drama • Biography

⭐ IMDb: 8.1/10

⏱️ Runtime: 2h 21m • PG-13

🎥 Director: Steven Spielberg
